text: The account holder is Tariq Nawaz with account number PK**MUCB****4062, opened on 6 July 2024. The subject declares a student occupation and a monthly income of PKR 25,000 per month. Between 2 April 2026 and 10 April 2026, the account received 17 credits totalling PKR 932,000 and made 4 debits totalling PKR 875,000. All 17 credits were interbank (IBFT) transfers from 13 distinct senders. Tazama flagged the activity on 10 April 2026, scoring 360 against a threshold of 300 for typology MULE-01. The presence of 13 distinct inbound senders in a short period is indicative of a potential money mule pattern. Debits equal to 94% of credits with a median of 4.5 hours between the latest credit and each debit suggest rapid value movement. The credits amounting to 37.3 times the declared monthly income are inconsistent with the subject's student profile and declared income. Two sender banks raised fraud recall requests against inbound transfers to this account, citing scam complaints. Taken together, these indicators are consistent with suspected money mule activity for a student with low declared income. PKR 642,000 was sent to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (WLT****0932, Synthetic EMI) in 3 transactions. PKR 233,000 was withdrawn as Cash (ATM) in 1 transaction. No match was found on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 28 April 2026. Outgoing wallet transfers were placed on hold pending review, with no contact made with the customer about this review.
